pick.headline: Bush proposes to move 'beyond containment'
pick.summary: In a commencement speech at Texas A&M University on May 12, 1989, President George Bush said that the United States should seek to move beyond containment and integrate the Soviet Union into the community of nations.
pick.significance: The speech set out the Bush administration's answer to Gorbachev after months of review: cautious engagement conditioned on Soviet deeds. Months later the Berlin Wall fell.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 092, 15 May 1989
evidence.snippet: …and freedom.” Since this is so, “our aim is bold and more ambitious than any of my predecessors could have thought possible.” It emerges that the administration has decided to expand the limits [rasshirit ramki] of the containment of “Soviet expansionism” and seek “the integration of the Soviet Union into the community of nations.” The word “seek” seems hardly appropriate here, since Bush said that we would have to “earn” this integration. How? B…
